title: Comparison of the reference values for the BREAST-Q modules for mastectomy, breast-conserving therapy, and breast reconstruction between a German population and the existing U.S. reference values
summary: In this study, healthy women in Germany are being surveyed online about their satisfaction with their own breasts. The study uses the globally recognized BREAST-Q questionnaire, which is otherwise used to evaluate breast surgery. To date, only U.S. benchmark data are available for this questionnaire. The goal of the study is to collect German benchmark data for the first time, in order to better interpret patients’ outcomes following breast surgery in the future. Participation is anonymous, voluntary, and takes about 15–20 minutes.

interventions.name:
Healthy women without breast disease or a history of breast surgery
A one-time, anonymous online survey of women aged 18 and older with no history of breast disease or breast surgery, using the preoperative BREAST-Q questionnaire (domains: Satisfaction with Breasts, Physical/Psychosocial/Sexual Wel

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
-    No known breast conditions (e.g., mastopathy, fibroadenomas, breast cancer) in the medical history 
-    No history of breast surgery (e.g., breast augmentation, reduction, lift, reconstructive procedures, breast cancer surgery)
-    Be able to complete a questionnaire independently and legibly
-    Electronic consent to participate in the study 
-    Sufficient knowledge of German to be able to answer the questionnaire confidently and without assistance
Exclusion criteria:
-    Past or current breast disease 
-    Surgery on one or both breasts 
-    Pregnancy or breastfeeding within the last 12 months 
-    Mental health conditions involving body image disturbances 
-    Lack of patient consent
-    Insufficient knowledge of German that would interfere with providing valid responses to the questionnaire
